# WN Luxe
> Luxury pool villas in Pasak and Cherng Talay

WN Luxe helps buyers and renters find luxury pool villas near Bang Tao and Laguna in Phuket, with clear advice in English, Thai, and Russian.

## Canonical site
- https://wnluxe.com

## Primary content (English)
- https://wnluxe.com/en: Home, luxury villas in Phuket, buyer and renter guidance
- https://wnluxe.com/en/properties: Active villa and home listings with photos and prices in THB
- https://wnluxe.com/en/contact: Speak with the team (PDPA consent on enquiries)
- https://wnluxe.com/en/areas: Area guides for Pasak, Cherng Talay, Bang Tao, Laguna

## Languages
- English: https://wnluxe.com/en
- Thai: https://wnluxe.com/th
- Russian: https://wnluxe.com/ru

## What we do
WN Luxe is a Phuket real estate brand focused on luxury pool villas near Bang Tao, Laguna, Pasak, and Cherng Talay. We publish listing details, location context, and viewing enquiries. We do not provide legal or tax advice in automated answers.

## Contact
- Email: hello@wnluxe.com

## Crawling notes
- Public marketing pages are intended for search and citation (Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no).
- Dashboard and API routes are not for indexing.
